design_philosophy: A bold, trustworthy, and futuristic B2B landing page. Focuses on premium, moody tech-aesthetics avoiding generic SaaS templates. Uses CSS 3D perspectives, glassmorphism, and neon-emerald accents to convey precision and automation.

headings.usage: Hero H1, section titles, button texts. Avoid center alignment for major headings.

body.usage: Subparagraphs, form labels, minor UI text.

layout_strategy.hero_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-8 items-center min-h-[85vh] pt-32 pb-20
layout_strategy.left_content: col-span-1 lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col items-start space-y-8

navbar.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F172A]/70 border-b border-white/5 transition-all duration-300
navbar.layout: flex justify-between items-center h-20 px-6 lg:px-12
navbar.links: hidden md:flex items-center space-x-8 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300
navbar.cta: bg-[#5B21B6] hover:bg-[#4C1D95] text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-md transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(91,33,182,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(91,33,182,0.6)]

hero_content.headline: Stop Losing Leads. Start Running Smarter.
hero_content.subparagraph: FloForge Automations helps contractors and local businesses organize leads, automate follow-ups, and build simple systems that keep daily operations running smoothly.

ctas.primary: Start Now - bg-[#5B21B6] hover:bg-[#4C1D95] text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(91,33,182,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_4px_30px_rgba(91,33,182,0.6)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 font-manrope
ctas.secondary: Let's Talk - border border-white/20 hover:border-white/60 bg-transparent text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 font-manrope backdrop-blur-sm

hero_3d_visual.wrapper_classes: w-full h-full perspective-[1200px] flex justify-center items-center
hero_3d_visual.container_classes: relative w-full max-w-lg transform-style-preserve-3d rotate-x-[8deg] rotate-y-[-12deg] hover:rotate-x-[5deg] hover:rotate-y-[-8deg] transition-transform duration-700 ease-out
hero_3d_visual.dashboard_base: w-full h-[400px] bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] relative overflow-hidden

floating_cards.label: New Lead
floating_cards.classes: absolute top-8 -left-8 bg-[#0F172A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl transform translate-z-[40px] animate-float-slow flex items-center gap-3

floating_cards.label: Follow-Up Task
floating_cards.classes: absolute top-32 right-[-20px] bg-[#312E81]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl transform translate-z-[60px] animate-float-medium flex items-center gap-3

floating_cards.label: Estimate Sent
floating_cards.classes: absolute bottom-32 left-12 bg-[#0F172A]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl transform translate-z-[30px] animate-float-fast flex items-center gap-3

floating_cards.label: Closed Won
floating_cards.classes: absolute bottom-8 right-8 bg-[#10B981]/20 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#10B981]/50 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)] transform translate-z-[80px] animate-float-slow flex items-center gap-3

hero_3d_visual.connector_lines: SVG overlay positioned absolutely within the 3D container. Paths connecting cards using stroke='url(#purple-emerald-gradient)' stroke-width='2' with stroke-dasharray animation to simulate data flow. Add drop-shadow to the SVG paths for glow.
hero_3d_visual.particles: Absolute positioned small div dots (w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-white/40) using Framer Motion to slowly drift upwards, creating atmospheric depth.

contact_form_lead_capture.strategy: Shadcn UI Form deeply customized. Dark luxury aesthetics. Avoid native inputs.
contact_form_lead_capture.trigger: Can be triggered via 'Let's Talk' CTA opening a customized Shadcn Dialog (Modal) with glassmorphism overlay.
contact_form_lead_capture.container_classes: bg-[#0F172A] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full
contact_form_lead_capture.inputs: bg-black/20 border-white/10 focus-visible:ring-[#5B21B6] focus-visible:border-[#5B21B6] text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 rounded-lg h-12
contact_form_lead_capture.button: w-full h-12 bg-[#5B21B6] hover:bg-[#4C1D95] text-white font-manrope tracking-wide shadow-lg rounded-lg transition-colors mt-4

motion_and_interactions.hero_entrance: Framer motion staggered entrance. Text content fades in and slides up (y: 20 -> 0) with a 0.1s stagger. Dashboard base scales up (0.95 -> 1) and fades in.
motion_and_interactions.floating_loop: Use Framer Motion or CSS keyframes to animate 'y' property of floating cards indefinitely. Vary the durations (e.g., 4s, 5s, 6s) and delays so they move out of sync.
motion_and_interactions.connector_pulse: CSS animation on SVG stroke-dashoffset to create moving light along the paths.
motion_and_interactions.button_hover: Scale 1.05, shadow intensity increase, slight translate-y negative.

background_texture.usage: Set as a fixed, absolutely positioned background layer behind the hero section with mix-blend-overlay and opacity-5 to add premium, gritty texture to the Deep Navy background, preventing 'flat SaaS' look.

testing_attributes.conventions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format based on role.

e1_specific_rules.border_radius: Concentric and subtle. Use rounded-lg for buttons, rounded-xl for floating cards, rounded-2xl for main dashboard base.
e1_specific_rules.spacing: Generous spacing. Use gap-12 between text and visual on desktop. Avoid tight clustering.
e1_specific_rules.typography_tension: Contrast the ultra-bold Manrope H1 with the precise, neutral Inter body text. Never center the left-column text.
e1_specific_rules.shadows: Layered ambient shadows. Avoid solid drop shadows. Use multiple layers e.g. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.12)] for realistic depth.
